llcFilesWith: Delaware Division of Revenue, online through Delaware One Stop (statewide Trade, Business & Fictitious Name registration; a Delaware business license is required alongside it)
soleProprietorFilesWith: Delaware Division of Revenue, online through Delaware One Stop (the same statewide registration applies to individuals and sole proprietors)
feeBasis: The registration fee is $25. Since February 2, 2026 the DBA is registered statewide, so a business operating in more than one county pays the fee once instead of per county.
renewalRule: The registration stays in effect until the owner terminates it; there is no periodic renewal of the DBA itself, though the Delaware business license it sits alongside follows the standard business licence renewal cycle.
protectionNote: The trade name certificate discloses who is behind a business name and grants no exclusive right to the name.
searchNote: The Division of Revenue publishes the statewide Trade, Business and Fictitious Names registry, refreshed daily and lagging One Stop registrations by up to 72 hours. Names registered with a county Prothonotary before February 2, 2026 remain in the Superior Court's historic database and were not migrated automatically.
notes: Delaware moved its DBA off the county courts on February 2, 2026. LLCs and sole proprietors now register a Trade, Business & Fictitious Name statewide with the Division of Revenue through Delaware One Stop (6 Del. C. ch. 31, which names the Division of Revenue as the filing office and creates the Delaware Tradename Registry). The fee is $25 once, not $25 per county, notarisation is no longer required, and registration requires an active Delaware business license; an entity that holds a Delaware LLC but does no business in Delaware uses a Trade Name Only business license instead. Registrations made with a Prothonotary before that date stay valid but sit in the Superior Court's historic list unless the owner re-registers them, at no cost, in the Revenue registry.
